Can't remember where I found the recipe, but it is decent and the bonus is this is portioned to be (American) single-serving sized. Be warned though, it is heavy on the sugar.

Ingredients

  • 1/4 cup flour
  • 1/4 cup sugar
  • 2 tablespoons cocoa powder
  • 2 tablespoons cooking oil (vegetable oil)
  • 3 tableapoons water

Directions

Mix flour, sugar, and cocoa powder thoroughly. Pour on oil and water, mix thoroughly again. Microwave for 2 minutes and 20 seconds (1100 watt microwave, adjust time to yours).

Serve with a good scoop of ice cream on top while hot.

Additions

If you want to go overboard, add chocolate chips or a flavor extract like mint or orange. If you get the flavor extracts from a store that sells "essential oils" of whatever brand, the mint or orange can go a long way. One drop tends to be plenty, two if you want it strong.

You can also swap out the cooking oil for coconut oil if you so desire.
Can it be done with less sugar.

I haven't tried it, but I would be happily surprised if it could be done. Or replace some of the sugar and oil with honey would be nice too.

Like I said, it is a huge amount that I would recommend making sparingly.
